objects.description: [OSX_OCEANLOTUS.D](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0352) uses the command xattr -d com.apple.quarantine to remove the quarantine file attribute used by Gatekeeper.(Citation: Trend Micro MacOS Backdoor November 2020)(Citation: 20 macOS Common Tools and Techniques)
objects.description_fa: [OSX_OCEANLOTUS.D](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0352) از فرمان xattr -d com.apple.quarantine برای حذف ویژگی فایل قرنطینه استفاده شده توسط Gatekeeper استفاده می‌کند.(Citation: Trend Micro MacOS Backdoor November 2020)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]] (Citation: 20 macOS Common Tools and Techniques)
